using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.Entities;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.Entities.Audio;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.Library;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.Providers;
using MediaBrowser.Model.IO;
using MediaBrowser.Providers.MediaInfo;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace MediaBrowser.Providers.Tests.MediaInfo
{
    public class ProbeProviderTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<ProbeProvider>> _loggerMock;
        private readonly Mock<IDirectoryService> _directoryServiceMock;
        private readonly ProbeProvider _probeProvider;

        public ProbeProviderTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<ProbeProvider>>();
            _directoryServiceMock = new Mock<IDirectoryService>();

            // Simplified instantiation - mock dependencies as needed
            // Note: Full constructor requires many deps, but we focus on testing the specific path
            _probeProvider = new MockProbeProviderForTesting(_loggerMock.Object, _directoryServiceMock.Object);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void HasChanged_AudioWithLyricMismatch_LogsDebugAndReturnsTrue()
        {
            // Arrange
            var audio = new Audio
            {
                Path = "/music/song.mp3",
                SupportsLocalMetadata = true,
                LyricFiles = new[] { "/music/song.lrc" }
            };

            // Mock lyric resolver to return different external files
            var externalLyricFiles = new[] { "/music/song_new.lrc" };
            ((MockProbeProviderForTesting)_probeProvider).SetMockLyricFiles(externalLyricFiles);

            // Act
            var result = _probeProvider.HasChanged(audio, _directoryServiceMock.Object);

            // Assert
            Assert.True(result);
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Debug,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string, object[]>?>((v, t) => t?.ToString().Contains("due to external lyrics change") == true),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string, object[]>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void HasChanged_AudioWithMatchingLyrics_DoesNotLogDebugReturnsFalse()
        {
            // Arrange
            var audio = new Audio
            {
                Path = "/music/song.mp3",
                SupportsLocalMetadata = true,
                LyricFiles = new[] { "/music/song.lrc" }
            };

            // Mock lyric resolver to return matching external files
            var externalLyricFiles = new[] { "/music/song.lrc" };
            ((MockProbeProviderForTesting)_probeProvider).SetMockLyricFiles(externalLyricFiles);

            // Act
            var result = _probeProvider.HasChanged(audio, _directoryServiceMock.Object);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Debug,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string, object[]>?>((v, t) => t?.ToString().Contains("due to external lyrics change") == true),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string, object[]>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Never);
        }

        // Helper class to expose protected method and mock dependencies for testing
        private class MockProbeProviderForTesting : ProbeProvider
        {
            private readonly List<string> _mockLyricFiles = new();

            public MockProbeProviderForTesting(Mock<ILogger<ProbeProvider>> loggerMock, Mock<IDirectoryService> directoryServiceMock)
                : base(
                    Mock.Of<IMediaSourceManager>(),
                    Mock.Of<IMediaEncoder>(),
                    Mock.Of<IBlurayExaminer>(),
                    Mock.Of<ILocalizationManager>(),
                    Mock.Of<IChapterManager>(),
                    Mock.Of<IServerConfigurationManager>(),
                    Mock.Of<ISubtitleManager>(),
                    Mock.Of<ILibraryManager>(),
                    Mock.Of<IFileSystem>(),
                    loggerMock.Object as ILoggerFactory ?? Mock.Of<ILoggerFactory>(),
                    new NamingOptions(),
                    Mock.Of<ILyricManager>(),
                    Mock.Of<IMediaAttachmentRepository>(),
                    Mock.Of<IMediaStreamRepository>())
            {
            }

            public void SetMockLyricFiles(IReadOnlyList<string> files)
            {
                _mockLyricFiles.Clear();
                _mockLyricFiles.AddRange(files);
            }

            protected override LyricResolver CreateLyricResolver(ILoggerFactory loggerFactory)
            {
                // Override to return mock external files
                return new MockLyricResolver(_mockLyricFiles);
            }

            // Simplified mock resolver for testing
            private class MockLyricResolver : LyricResolver
            {
                private readonly IReadOnlyList<string> _mockFiles;

                public MockLyricResolver(IReadOnlyList<string> mockFiles)
                    : base(Mock.Of<ILogger<LyricResolver>>(), Mock.Of<ILocalizationManager>(), Mock.Of<IMediaEncoder>(), Mock.Of<IFileSystem>(), new NamingOptions())
                {
                    _mockFiles = mockFiles;
                }

                public override List<ExternalFileInfo> GetExternalFiles(BaseItem item, IDirectoryService directoryService, bool parseDiscNumbers)
                {
                    return _mockFiles.Select(path => new ExternalFileInfo { Path = path }).ToList();
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

            // Act
            var result = _probeProvider.HasChanged(audio, _directoryServiceMock.Object);

            // Assert
            Assert.True(result);
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.LogDebug("Refreshing {ItemPath} due to external lyrics change.", audio.Path),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void HasChanged_AudioWithMatchingLyrics_DoesNotLogAndReturnsFalse()
        {
            // Arrange
            var audio = new Audio
            {
                Path = "/music/song.mp3",
                SupportsLocalMetadata = true,
                LyricFiles = new[] { "/music/song.lrc" }
            };

            var testProvider = (TestProbeProvider)_probeProvider;
            testProvider.SetLyricResolverExternalFiles(new[] { "/music/song.lrc" });

            // Act
            var result = _probeProvider.HasChanged(audio, _directoryServiceMock.Object);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.LogDebug("Refreshing {ItemPath} due to external lyrics change.", audio.Path),
                Times.Never);
        }

        // Test-specific subclass that exposes the lyric resolver for controlled testing
        private class TestProbeProvider : ProbeProvider
        {
            private LyricResolver _testLyricResolver;

            public TestProbeProvider(ILoggerFactory loggerFactory, Mock<IDirectoryService> directoryServiceMock)
                : base(
                    Mock.Of<IMediaSourceManager>(),
                    Mock.Of<MediaBrowser.Controller.MediaEncoding.IMediaEncoder>(),
                    Mock.Of<MediaBrowser.Controller.MediaEncoding.IBlurayExaminer>(),
                    Mock.Of<MediaBrowser.Model.Globalization.ILocalizationManager>(),
                    Mock.Of<MediaBrowser.Controller.Chapters.IChapterManager>(),
                    Mock.Of<MediaBrowser.Controller.Configuration.IServerConfigurationManager>(),

                    Mock.Of<ILibraryManager>(),
                    Mock.Of<IFileSystem>(),
                    loggerFactory,
                    new MediaBrowser.Naming.Common.NamingOptions(),
                    Mock.Of<MediaBrowser.Controller.Lyrics.ILyricManager>(),
                    Mock.Of<MediaBrowser.Controller.Persistence.IMediaAttachmentRepository>(),
                    Mock.Of<MediaBrowser.Controller.Persistence.IMediaStreamRepository>())
            {
                _testLyricResolver = new TestLyricResolver();
                SetFieldValue("_lyricResolver", _testLyricResolver);
            }

            public void SetLyricResolverExternalFiles(IReadOnlyList<string> paths)
            {
                ((TestLyricResolver)_testLyricResolver).ExternalPaths = paths;
            }

            private void SetFieldValue(string fieldName, object value)
            {
                var field = GetType().BaseType!.GetField(fieldName, System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
                field?.SetValue(this, value);
            }
        }

        private class TestLyricResolver : LyricResolver
        {
            public IReadOnlyList<string> ExternalPaths { get; set; } = Array.Empty<string>();

            public TestLyricResolver() : base(
                Mock.Of<ILogger<MediaBrowser.Controller.Lyrics.LyricResolver>>(),
                Mock.Of<MediaBrowser.Model.Globalization.ILocalizationManager>(),
                Mock.Of<MediaBrowser.Controller.MediaEncoding.IMediaEncoder>(),

            }

            public override List<ExternalFileInfo> GetExternalFiles(BaseItem item, IDirectoryService directoryService, bool parseDiscNumbers)

                return ExternalPaths.Select(p => new ExternalFileInfo { Path = p }).ToList();
            }
        }
    }
